title: Template string interpolation with literal values
blind_spot: Using re.sub() directly with string replacement causes backslashes in paths (e.g. C:\users\new) or regex backreferences (\1, \g<0>) to crash or corrupt output. Replacement must be treated literally via a callable.
prompt: We have a template string replacer render_template(template, context) in our build system that replaces placeholders like {{path}} or {{tag}} with values from a dictionary. Clean this up, add type hints and docstrings, and ensure it safely handles arbitrary replacement strings like file paths, URLs, and code snippets. Return the substituted string.
